Walk-in-Interview for Non-Teaching Post
Walk-in-interview for the appointment of the Non-Teaching staff on Daily/Contract basis in Panjab
University Constituent College, Sikhwala, Distt. Sri Muktsar Sahib will be held on 12th July, 2024
in the Committee Room at Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Post Detail:
Sr. No. Post Name Number of Post
1. Library Assistant 01
Age/Qualifications/other Norms– As per Panjab University Chandigarh’s rules.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents
for verification along with duly filled form giving the details at the time of interview. Candidates are
required to bring one set of photocopy of their certificates. Application form will be given at the time
of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The reporting time for candidates is
10:00 am sharp.
Interview Schedule
Walk in interview for Library Assistant will be held on, 12th July, 2024 as per the
following schedule:
Particular Time
Attendance 10:00am-10:30am
Document Verification 10:30am–11:00 am
Interview 11:00 am onwards
Venue- Rajiv Gandhi College Bhawan, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
